map.厚度分级：≥3.5 mm 头层厚皮（鞋面、皮带等高强度用途）；1.2~3.5 m: Thickness grading: ≥3.5 mm thick top grain (high strength uses such as shoe uppers and belts); 1.2~3.5 mm regular top grain (general fabric, bags, shoe uppers); 0.8~1.2 mm thin top grain / split (clothing, gloves, lining); <0.8 mm thin split (lining, decoration). Area grading: ≥25 ft² large hide (complete large hide, high utilization); 15~25 ft² medium hide; 8~15 ft² small hide (small piece cutting); <8 ft² scrap hide (offcuts pieced together). Overall grade = layer (top grain if thickness ≥0.8, otherwise split) + area grade.

Thickness 0.6 mm, area 30 ft²: thickness <0.8 grades as split and the area is a large hide, so the overall grade is 'split large hide', suitable only for lining or decoration and not for load-bearing parts.
